title: aspidium nymphale
intro: Aspidium nymphale, commonly known as Lady fern or Nephrolepis, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Aspidium nymphale include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and aid in digestion, while its therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
